articles.title: Mother of child taken in reported abduction said she was "freaking out"
articles.description: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo. (KMIZ) The mother of a baby who was reported to have been abducted in Lebanon said she was left panicking after it happened Tuesday morning. articles.title: Iran will not allow enriched nuclear material to leave the country, security chief says
articles.description: DUBAI, Nov 11 (Reuters) - Iran will not allow even a single particle of enriched nuclear material to leave the country and there will be consequences in the event of any new US strikes on the Islamic Republic, Iranian security chiefMohsen Rezaei said in televised remarks.Rezaei was speaking to Lebanon's pro-Iranian Al Mayadeen TV after US officials downplayed the need for additional military action against Iran, with analysts noting President Donald Trump's more conciliatory tone since the Republicans' defeat in the November 3 midterm elections.

articles.title: Iraq bars plane carrying Iran's soccer team from landing in Basra over US sanctions, officials say
articles.description: BASRA, Iraq, Nov 10 (Reuters) - Iraq barred a plane carrying Iran's national soccer team from landing at Basra airport on Tuesday, a decision by the Iraqi Civil Aviation Authority linked to US sanctions imposed on Iranian airlines, two Basra airport officials said.The plane returned to Iran and landed at Abadan airport, and the team will now travel overland to Basra, an Iranian consulate official in Basra said.The Iranian team was travelling to Iraq to participate in a four-nation tournament in Basra also involving Iraq, Lebanon and Palestine.
